title: 第09章 退婚戏码第10章 暗中锋芒露
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 徐长老缓缓开口，声音带着一丝刻意后的威严。他看向主位上面沉似水的老太君，“方老夫人，这位是……？”
老太君心中冷笑，眼前的这徐长老岂会不知来人是谁？方家如今除了她这个老婆子，就只剩下一个病弱的方云逸。
对方此行目的明确，此刻却故作不知，无非是想摆足姿态，甚至可能是想亲眼确认一下方云逸这病秧子是否真的还活着，状况如何。
她强压下心头被羞辱的怒火，声音平稳却是带着冷淡。“徐长老，你何必明知故问？这便是我那孙儿，方云逸。”
老太君抬头看向方云逸，语气缓和些，带起眼里的慈爱，却透露着一丝无奈和提醒。
“逸儿，这几位是玄云宗的贵客。这位是徐长老，这位是赵峰，而这位……是林家小姐，林慕清。”
方云逸微微颔首，目光平静地扫过徐长老和赵峰，至于林慕清，他仿佛只是扫视全场时无意间掠过，并未做任何停留。
老太君的介绍虽简略，但结合刚才在门外听到的只言片语，他已然明白这三人今日的来意。
心中不由觉得有些荒谬，他灵魂穿越而来，竟会遇上这等上门退婚的经典戏码。
不过，他灵魂来自二十一世纪，对长辈之命的婚约本就不在意，更何况是这种未曾谋面、毫无感情基础的所谓婚约。
如今方府没落，对方觉得是攀附，那解除便是，于他而言，反倒是卸下一个不必要的包袱。
他自然不会像某些故事主角那般，热血上涌，喊出什么“三十年河东，三十年河西”的誓言。
这些戏码，在他看来，既无必要，也似乎太过于幼稚。
至于个人情绪？或许有一丝因对方态度而泛起的冷意，但也绝无被“羞辱”的愤怒，更多的是一种洞悉世情的淡漠。
“原来如此。”方云逸的声音平淡，加上他那张病态脸庞的缘故，看不出喜怒。
“几位是为了当年那桩婚约而来，今日想要取回信物，是吗？”他直接点明了主题，没有丝毫拖泥带水。
老太君看着方云逸平静得有些过分的反应，心中微微一叹。她自然看得出他并非故作镇定，而是真的不在意这段婚约。
这让她既感欣慰，又觉心酸。欣慰的是他心性坚韧，不为外物所扰。而心酸的是，方家竟已沦落到连曾经的婚约都保不住，需要受人如此逼迫的地步。
老太君确实有些不舍，这婚约是老头子当年为最疼爱的幼孙定下，也曾寄托着对方家未来的一份期望。
但如今时过境迁，方家败落，方云逸的身体……这些年，她唯一的念想就是他能平安度过余生。
要是与玄云宗硬碰，当下绝非明智之举。她默默点了点头，算是承认了方云逸的猜测。
“祖母，”方云逸转向老太君，语气温和而坚定，“既然林家小姐已有更好的前程，我方家如今境况也确实……不宜耽误人家。”
“强扭的瓜不甜，这门亲事，便依他们所请，解除了吧。还请祖母将那块青鸾玉佩取出，交还给他们便是。”
老太君看着他清澈而坚定的眼神，终是长叹一声，对侍立在厅堂后的赵嬷嬷微微颔首。
赵嬷嬷眼角含泪，带着愤恨与不甘，但还是依言转身入内。片刻之后，捧着一个略显陈旧的锦盒出来。
看到方家如此识相，赵峰脸上顿时露出得意和轻蔑的笑容，忍不住讥讽。
content_en:
Elder Xu spoke slowly, with a hint of deliberate majesty in his voice. He looked at the old lady who was sinking like water on the main seat, "Mrs. Fang, is this...?"
The old lady sneered in her heart, how could Elder Xu in front of him not know who the visitor was? Apart from her, the old woman, the only one left in the Fang family now is the frail Fang Yunyi.
The purpose of this trip was clear, but at this moment he was pretending not to know. He just wanted to show off, and maybe even wanted to confirm with his own eyes whether Fang Yunyi, the sick man, was really still alive and what his condition was.
She suppressed the anger of being humiliated in her heart, and her voice was calm but cold. "Elder Xu, why do you ask questions knowingly? This is my grandson, Fang Yunyi."
The old lady raised her head and looked at Fang Yunyi, her tone was gentler, her eyes were filled with kindness, but there was also a hint of helplessness and reminder.
"Yi'er, these are distinguished guests from the Xuanyun Sect. This is Elder Xu, this is Zhao Feng, and this... is Miss Lin, Lin Muqing."
Fang Yunyi nodded slightly and glanced calmly at Elder Xu and Zhao Feng. As for Lin Muqing, he seemed to have just glanced at the whole place inadvertently without making any stop.
Although the old lady's introduction was brief, but combined with the few words he heard outside the door just now, he already understood the purpose of these three people's visit today.
He couldn't help but feel a little ridiculous in his heart. His soul traveled through time and space, and he would encounter this classic drama of breaking off the engagement at home.
However, his soul comes from the 21st century, and he doesn't care about the marriage contract ordered by his elders, let alone this so-called marriage contract that he has never met and has no emotional basis.
Now that the Fang Mansion is in decline, the other party feels that it is clinging to him, so the removal is, for him, it is actually removing an unnecessary burden.
Naturally, he would not be like the protagonists of some stories, with blood boiling and shouting the oath of "thirty years to the east of the river, thirty years to the west of the river".
In his opinion, these dramas were unnecessary and seemed too childish.
As for personal emotions? There may be a hint of coldness due to the other party's attitude, but there is absolutely no anger at being "humiliated". It is more of a kind of indifference that understands the world.
"I see." Fang Yunyi's voice was calm, and because of his sickly face, there was no trace of happiness or anger.
"You guys are here for the engagement that happened back then, and you want to get the token back today, right?" He pointed out the topic directly without any hesitation.
The old lady sighed slightly in her heart when she saw Fang Yunyi's too calm reaction. She could naturally see that he was not pretending to be calm, but that he really didn't care about this engagement.
This made her feel both relieved and sad. Fortunately, he has a strong mind and is not disturbed by external things. What's sad is that the Fang family has fallen to the point where they can't even keep their previous engagement and have to be forced to do so.
The old lady was indeed a little reluctant to give up. This marriage contract was made by the old man for his beloved grandson, and it also placed his family's future hopes on it.
But now times have changed, the Fang family has declined, Fang Yunyi's body... In these years, her only thought is that he can spend the rest of his life safely.
It would definitely not be a wise move at the moment to have a head-on confrontation with the Xuanyun Sect. She nodded silently, admitting Fang Yunyi's guess.
"Grandma," Fang Yunyi turned to the old lady with a gentle but firm tone, "Since Miss Lin's family has a better future, our Fang family's current situation is indeed... it is not appropriate to delay others."
"It's not sweet to be forced, so let's cancel this marriage at their request. Please also ask grandma to take out the Qingluan jade pendant and return it to them."
The old lady looked at his clear and firm eyes, finally sighed, and nodded slightly to Aunt Zhao, who was standing at the back of the hall.
Aunt Zhao had tears in her eyes, filled with resentment and unwillingness, but she still turned around and went in as she was told. After a while, he came out holding a slightly old brocade box.
Seeing that the Fang family was so understanding, Zhao Feng suddenly showed a proud and contemptuous smile on his face, and couldn't help but ridicule.
title_en: Chapter 09 The drama of breaking off the engagement Chapter 10 The hidden edge is revealed
